More than a learning solutions provider, Blossom is an engaged, active partner that helps organisations transform and adapt as their needs and business grow. Already trusted by over 1 million users and 300 enterprises across 30 countries, globally. Blossom’s roots Our story so far… 2007 – Blossom makes its debut Blossom started life when its 2 founders – Roey and Tal – realised the LMS they were using to deliver vocational training didn’t account for different needs or capabilities of their learners, and so decided to create their own adaptive learning platform. 2010 – A new direction Impressed with what Roey and Tal were building, tech entrepreneur Eldad Nir invested seed capital to help move Blossom to a new stage of growth. The following year he joined as CEO and took over the day-to-day running of the company with a new focus on the enterprise market. 2014 – Blossom goes global A multi-million dollar project provided us with the stability to invest further into the product. This project also saw Blossom used by a company based outside of the company’s geographical location for the first time. 2016 – HR portal module released 2017 – Project management module released 2018 – A new HQ and ISO certification In a year that saw us move into a 3rd new office (and current HQ) in the space of 6 years, 2018 also saw us receive ISO27001 certification for the first time – a status we’ve continued to hold ever since. 2022 – LXP functionality released 2023 – Official UK launch and SOC 2 certification Blossom ramp-up their presence in the UK market by exhibiting for the first time at major UK L&D events such as The World Of Learning and E-Technologies. In the same year Blossom are awarded SOC 2 Compliance following a rigorous audit into the security and integrity of the platform.
